label: B25-M20K-READ-ALIGNMENT
title: Prove and repair synthesis-only boot M20K read-response alignment
scope: Model altera_syncram as a clocked synchronous RAM, demonstrate that the pre-fix synthesis wrapper returns stale data on the first accepted read, then preserve the public single-outstanding/one-cycle response contract by holding the accepted RAM address and offset until retirement and exposing only the corresponding post-edge q value. Align the debug port offset with the synchronous q_b value as well.

reset_and_commit_contract.reset: All new held address/offset/read metadata reset to zero. rsp_valid remains reset-low through rsp_pending. No architectural state is added.
reset_and_commit_contract.request_commit: Address, byte offset, fault and request kind are captured only on req_accept. Writes retain their existing accept-edge side effect.
reset_and_commit_contract.read_response: For an accepted read, rsp_valid becomes visible after the accept edge together with the post-edge M20K q_a for the held address; data and fault remain stable until rsp_ready.
reset_and_commit_contract.debug_response: dbg_addr is sampled by the synchronous RAM and its offset is captured on the same edge; dbg_rdata combines the corresponding q_b and captured offset without an additional stale capture.

L0: A vendor-faithful synchronous altera_syncram stub test fails on the old wrapper at the first PC=0-equivalent read and passes after the fix.
The test covers consecutive addresses, unaligned in-word offset, response backpressure stability, byte write/readback, range/cross-word fault and debug-port alignment.
L1: B25 ELF-derived BRAM initialization/oracle test passes.
Quartus synthesis-selector checker still selects exactly one in-file altera_syncram implementation and recognizes init_file/M20K.
L2: B25 SoC CAL-OK/CAL-WAIT/CAL-FAIL smoke passes with LCVEX25 BOOT, READY, PONG and echo markers.
Affected compile/lint checks pass without disabling assertions or changing reference results.

acceptance: The pre-fix failure is preserved in evidence, the corrected synthesis-only wrapper returns the reset-vector word on the first read with stable backpressure semantics, existing behavior-level and B25 oracle/SoC tests remain green, and no QSF/SDC/vendor IP/board action is used to hide the defect.
